title: ✨ Just pushed an update for TileMaker DOT FREE (v2.7.1)
author: ObjectiveCrysis22
selftext:
Hey everyone!:) Just rolled out a new update for the FREE version of TileMaker DOT, focusing on some great project customization options and helpful quality-of-life polishes!

Here is what's new in this build:

Customizable Project Icons: You can now click the (edit) icon next to any recent project to open a new icon selection modal and choose from a variety of custom map icon variations (or revert to the default icon instantly).

Clear History Action: Added a clean and accessible Clear History button directly to the welcome dashboard to keep your recent projects panel tidy with a single click.

Export Toast Notifications: Exporting IDs lists now triggers a smooth on-screen toast notification for immediate feedback when data is successfully processed and saved.

🕹️ Official page Itch.io: https://crytek22.itch.io/tilemakerdot

💻 GitHub: https://github.com/andrei-voia/TileMakerDOT

📺 YouTube tutorials: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3fiajGU32Jg

For anyone unfamiliar with the project, TileMaker DOT is a free, open-source 2D map editor I'm building (with a very complete, professional Pro version too). It uses a data-first, ID-based workflow and handles visual depth sorting automatically so you don't have to juggle complex layer setups for object heights.

Give it a try and let me know if you have any feedback! If the editor helps with your projects and you want to support development, a rating or a small donation on Itch is always hugely appreciated.

Thank you all so much for your continued support!
